subject.title: Fix automatic quota display priority for exhausted windows & Antigravity session preference

question: Should the menu bar intentionally stop surfacing Claude/GPT Antigravity quota families in automatic mode and show Gemini-only status for existing users?
rationale: The branch deliberately removes an existing user-visible automatic-selection behavior; preserving compatibility versus simplifying the status display is a product and upgrade-policy choice, not a mechanical review decision.

options.title: Preserve current automatic coverage
options.body: Keep the existing cross-family automatic behavior as the upgrade default and split any Gemini-only display mode into an explicitly approved, compatible change.

options.title: Adopt Gemini-only status
options.body: Accept the compatibility change, document the new menu-bar scope, and add upgrade and runtime proof showing Claude/GPT remain discoverable in the card.

options.title: Pause the simplification
options.body: Land only the bounded exhausted-window fix after its regression coverage and defer Antigravity display-policy changes to a separate proposal.

recommendation.title: Preserve current automatic coverage
recommendation.body: Keep the existing cross-family automatic behavior as the upgrade default and split any Gemini-only display mode into an explicitly approved, compatible change.

likelyOwner.reason: The needed choice concerns the product contract for an existing menu-bar provider surface.
